title: Environment georeference
description: Where on Earth an environment's origin sits, Clients provide the five location fields; the server sets contract_version, source, anchor_status, set_at and set_by, and replaces the whole object on every write. heading_deg is the true-north bearing of the environment's +Y axis in degrees clockwise.

latitude.description: WGS-84 latitude of the environment origin, in degrees.

longitude.description: WGS-84 longitude of the environment origin, in degrees.

altitude.description: Altitude in metres, in altitude_datum, at environment z == 0.

altitude_datum.description: Datum the altitude is expressed in.

heading_deg.description: True-north bearing of the environment +Y axis, degrees clockwise.

anchor_status.description: unverified after an environment is cloned, until the georeference is confirmed again.

set_at.description: When the georeference was set, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

set_by.description: UUID of the user who set the georeference.
